name: the start page gets no table to render into
why: The rows all come from fetched year pages; renderFinalTable() needs a table.tbl tbody on the live page, which only _bbHomeEmptyTable() provides.

name: the start page is not behind the year-page switch
why: The start page shares the year pages' opt-in; without its path in the gate the toolbar appears with sa_bb_year_pages off.

name: a Brucebase table docks at scrollX 0
why: A first sticky column counts as docked unscrolled, and its page-coloured gutter mask painted over the wiki side bar.

name: Venue is the sticky column again
why: A sticky column after Date makes Date and Type 'columns before the sticky one'; the spec pins Date as the one sticky column.
